text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A play is being put on as part of an
academy event. On my way there, I spot
two students wearing fancy costumes
bowing in a frantic
motion.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We've been asked to step in for some
students who can't make it! Now it's time
to give the crowd
a taste of my acting
skills!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, we're not supposed to stand
out. Teio, you're playing "Servant A,"
and I'm playing "Maid
B." These are
supporting roles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The play is off to a good start. But just
as the
story is approaching its climax...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Villain
text_block_list.text:
Wah, ha, ha, ha! Everything is finally
within my grasp! The treasure, the
princess, this country, the
legendary
sword... and the real estate industry!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't let you have your way! Because
I...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
Because I... well...
Huh? Um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She appears to have forgotten her lines,
perhaps due to nerves. Commotion
spreads among the audience, who had
been watching the play with bated
breath...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because! There's no need for my master
to toil
away when I, Teio the servant, am
here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll vanquish any knaves of your ilk! Take
this!
Ultimate Teio Spinning Kick!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Villain
text_block_list.text: Huh? Aaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Audience Member A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That move looked like it was
straight out
of an action movie! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Your end is nigh, scoundrel! Feel the
power of a
Teio Hurricane followed by a
Teio Plasma Blast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio performs one impressive stunt
after
another, turning the play into a
one-Uma show!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... My servant is magnificent
indeed! But I,
uh, think that's enough...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Master! Your kindness knows no
bounds!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You refrained from raising your hand
against this wicked fiend... For even a
villain must have
reason for their
misdeeds!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Which is no doubt why Teio, inferring
the master's
feelings, chose to act in her
stead.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...!
That is most correct! I will perform
such duties
without qualm!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
R-right! Forgive me for burdening you so.
However, the evil has been
vanquished thanks to
your efforts. Let us
return home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They somehow manage to get the play
back on
track, and the curtain falls on a
high note.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry about what happened! I
thought I needed to do something, but
before I realized it,
I had gone a little
overboard...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
D-don't sweat it, really! If you weren't
there to
help, the whole scene would've
been a disaster!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Not to mention, you took my
ad-libbed line
and ran with it. It was
seamless.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, you're the one who held this play 
together, Nature. You stayed in
character the whole time and put the
spotlight back on our
lead.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The applause may have been directed at
me, but
you were the coolest actor on
stage. I mean it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The applause may have been directed at
me, but
you were the coolest actor on
stage. I mean it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seconded. All I did was follow your lead.
There's
no way I could have stirred up
excitement in the
crowd like that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Villain
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's time for our curtain call! Let's
go,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then I should whip out a
special move to
cap off the experience
and—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait! Bad idea! I've got to let the
lead have
her limelight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning that sometimes it can be pretty
cool to step back and play the
supporting role, Tokai
Teio further
matures to an extent.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then I should whip out a
special move to
cap off the experience!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold it!
You're trying to hog the
spotlight again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite discovering a new style of cool,
it seems like actually putting it into
practice will take
some time for Tokai
Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You think so? That settles it—time to
really
embody that cool, mature vibe!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First things first!
I need to help out with
the other
attractions until this event is
over!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Today, the mighty Teio will be a helper
hero to
all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning that sometimes it can be pretty
cool to step back and play the
supporting role, Tokai
Teio further
matures to an extent.
